title.narrative: Research and Innovation Systems Africa (RISA) Fund

description.narrative: The Research Innovation for Africa (RISA) Fund is a multi-country UK government-funded project that aims to support research and innovation systems strengthening in Africa by bringing together two Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO) Research and Evidence Division (RED) programs under the RISA Fund umbrella: Strengthening Research Institutions in Africa (ATIP) and the African Technology and Innovation Partnerships (ATIP). The RISA Fund enables the two programmes to more effectively realise the synergies between their objectives of strengthening research and innovation systems
